dialog.text:
Turn on Require Ordering Parts?
close

You will click Order on each part to record that you have ordered it.

123 parts at this location are affected by this requirement today. No record is changed by this switch.

Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in.

Cancel
Turn On

Turn on Require Picking Inventory Parts?
close

You will click Pick on each inventory and found part to record that it has been pulled.

57 parts at this location are affected by this requirement today. No record is changed by this switch.

Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in. None of them is un-picked.

Cancel
Turn On

Turn on Require Approval for New Lines?
close

New work order lines will need approval before work starts on them.

50 lines at this location are affected by this requirement today. No record is changed by this switch.

Lines already on a work order keep the status they have. None of them is sent back for approval.

Cancel
Turn On

Turn off Require Receiving Parts Before Completion?
close

Ordered parts will no longer need to be received before a work order can be completed.

82 work orders waiting on parts can now be invoiced. No record is changed by this switch.

Parts already on a work order keep the state they are in.

Cancel
Turn Off
